meaning:
ὁσίως
(ὅσιος),
adv., [in LXX: 3Ki.8:61, Wis.6:10 * ;]
piously, holily: ὁ. καὶ δικαίως κ. ἀμέμπτως (on the distinction here between these synonyms, see M, Th., 24 f.), 1Th.2:10.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.
